parsed.rationale: All six members are empty type-alias-object declarations (fields_or_signature: []) that serve as SwiftUI @main app entry points, each with a distinct name tied to its own target: WXUISampleApp, WallpaperSampleApp, PlayerHeaderViewApp, PlayerHeaderViewSampleApp, WatchXYC, and WXYCTVApp. The structural similarity is purely coincidental — each alias is the root entry point of a separate executable target and cannot be merged or extracted without collapsing independent app targets into one. None carry restraint markers, but the domain reason for no-action is that each alias is load-bearing as the @main entry point of its own binary; sharing or lifting them would be architecturally incorrect.
